description: A chaotic oscillator with no inputs at all, giving two slowly wandering voltages from a modelled analogue circuit that never repeats

params.text: Adds up to 10 kilohms to a fixed 100 kilohms in the modelled circuit, which changes how long the voltages spend around one of the two attractors rather than the other; it does not change the rate

outputs.text: The narrower-swinging of the two voltages, taken from a different node of the same circuit
The wider-swinging of the two voltages, the one the lamp follows: green while it is positive, red while it is negative, full brightness at 2V

notes: there is nothing to patch in and no clock to give it: the circuit runs from the moment the module is added and both outputs are moving straight away.
one turn around the pair of attractors takes roughly 30 to 40 minutes, so a change at the knob takes minutes rather than seconds to show itself.
